units: <cite ref="Meilah 14b:14">Meïl. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>דילמא בעי למִיזְגָא וזגא עלייהו</he> he may desire to lie down and will lie down on them.
<cite ref="Gittin 47a:6">Gitt. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>למִזְגָא עליה</he> to recline on (while eating).
<cite ref="Pesachim 108a:11">Pes. 108ᵃ</cite> <he>זְגִינָן אבירכי וכ׳</he> we reclined (at the Passover meal) against the knees &c.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 124b:19">Sabb. 124ᵇ</cite> <he>חזו למזגא עלייהו</he> they may be used for sitting on them (when seats are improvised).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 85b:21">Snh. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>דז׳ עליה</he> he leaned on him. [Tanḥ. Ki Thetsé 6, a. e. <he>למזגי</he>, v. <cite ref="C00541"><he>גְּזֵי</he></cite>.] [<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 10:22">Targ. Y. Deut. X, 22</cite> <he>למזגי</he> ed. pr., v. <cite ref="M01845"><he>מִסְגֵּי</he></cite>.]
Sabb. 119ᵃ top לא מַזְגִּינָא וכ׳ some ed. מַזִּיגְנָא Pa.) I do not rest my head upon my pillow before &c.
